description: Input data for expeditedSnap evaluation. All fields are optional — partial inputs trigger partial evaluation.

household.description: Household financial circumstances at the time of application.

monthlyGrossIncome.description: Total monthly gross income for all household members (dollars).

liquidResources.description: Total liquid resources (cash, bank accounts) available to the household (dollars).

monthlyShelterCost.description: Monthly shelter cost including rent/mortgage and utilities (dollars).

isMigrantFarmworker.description: Whether any household member is a migrant or seasonal farmworker.

incomeThreshold.description: Monthly gross income threshold for expedited eligibility (7 CFR § 273.2(i)(1)(i)).

resourceThreshold.description: Liquid resource threshold for expedited eligibility (7 CFR § 273.2(i)(1)(i)).
